summary.name: Studio 3T
summary.one_liner: Studio 3T is a GUI and governance platform for MongoDB that lets data teams and AI agents query data while enforcing access controls and masking sensitive fields.
use_cases: Giving AI coding assistants MongoDB schema context
Masking sensitive data in MongoDB pipelines
Auditing which humans and AI agents query a database
Letting analysts ask plain-English questions of MongoDB data
Governing central database connections for an organization
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Studio 3T as a platform for MongoDB aimed at multiple roles: developers, data engineers/DBAs, IT administrators, analysts, business leaders and procurement. It says 3T MCP gives AI coding tools MongoDB schema context so generated queries work against the data. It says 3T Access provides a full audit trail and central control over connections, human or AI. It claims data masking at the pipeline layer and access enforcement at the identity layer. It mentions three tracks and six products, though the page does not detail them.
notable: 3T MCP provides MongoDB schema context to AI coding tools
3T Access gives audit trail and central connection control for humans and AI agents
Masks sensitive data at the pipeline layer
caveats: Page does not state pricing tiers; procurement section mentions pricing models without details
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete technical specifics
Listing on awesome-mac describes it as freeware, but the page itself does not confirm licensing
